case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal 4600070620 — pricing and contract options
move.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

We plan to renew for 20,000 pieces annually from 1 January 2027.

Forecast fc:360020@2026-09 shows annual demand growth of 4.2%, supporting a longer-term agreement.

Our existing agreement ctr:4600070620 provides 60-day payment terms; please retain these for the renewal.

Could you provide a cost breakdown explaining the proposed price increase, including purchasing, logistics and service costs? What savings could a 36-month agreement deliver compared with 24 months?

We propose the following fixed-price packages, retaining the quoted delivery and quality terms. Could you support either option?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

However, we are very pleased to work with you and want to maintain our great relationship! We agree to reinstate the 60-day payment terms from your previous contract. For a 24-month agreement, we can offer a revised price of €4.91 per unit. 

To summarize, our offer is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal 4600070620 – longer-term pricing options
move.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for retaining the payment terms and improving your price.

Forecast fc:360020@2026-09 records annual demand of 28,600 pieces, supporting continuity of demand.

Could a 36-month fixed-price agreement reduce your purchasing and administration costs sufficiently to improve the unit price? Would 30-day payment unlock a further discount?

We have moved our proposed prices upward and offer the following alternatives for 20,000 pieces annually, retaining the quoted delivery and quality terms. Please indicate which package is workable and your best achievable price for it.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present our offer of a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

We acknowledge your revised proposals; however, the forecast data you cited was already factored into our previous calculations, and we have already taken that volume change data into account. In exchange for your proposed 30-day payment terms and a 36-month contract, we can reduce our price to €4.88 per unit.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please provide the data supporting your assumptions regarding our purchasing and administration costs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal 4600070620 – revised packages
move.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the additional option. The €0.03 reduction does not offset the financing cost of paying 30 days earlier, so we prefer retaining 60-day payment.

Could you separate the savings available from a 36-month commitment from those attributable to earlier payment? Could consolidated ordering reduce your administration costs without changing the agreed deliveries?

We have increased our proposed prices again. Please consider the two packages below, retaining the quoted delivery and quality terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued interest in our products and for bringing your business to Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Therefore, we are unable to offer further price reductions and must maintain our position. Our offer of €4.91 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 60-day payment terms remains our best possible price. For your reference, our offer includes a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

As a matter of transparency regarding our costs, material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please also be aware that this proposal is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
